map.跟随节拍器敲击（空格键或点击），实时反馈击打与节拍的偏差，训练节奏稳定性与律动感: Tap along with the metronome (spacebar or click) and get real-time feedback on the deviation between your hit and the beat, training rhythmic stability and pulse feel. It targets drummers and instrumentalists training their sense of rhythm.
map.跟节拍器敲击，实时看与拍点的偏差毫秒改善时值: Tap along with the metronome and see in real time how far you are from the beat in milliseconds, improving your timing
map.练复杂节奏型（切分、三连音）的稳定性: Practise complex rhythmic patterns (syncopation, triplets) for stability
map.记录准确率与标准差，跟踪一段时间进步: Record the accuracy and the standard deviation, and track progress over time
map.：100 BPM（拍 600 ms）连敲 8 次，偏差 [+12,−8,+5,−: At 100 BPM (600 ms per beat), 8 consecutive taps give deviations [+12,−8,+5,−15,+9,−3,+7,−10] ms → a mean of +0.375 and a standard deviation of about 9.4 ms; the smaller the standard deviation the steadier you are.
map.：在 120 BPM 两拍里弹「长-短-短」(占 500/250/250 ms): At 120 BPM over two beats, play "long-short-short" (occupying 500/250/250 ms) and the hits should land at 0, 500 and 750 ms; the feedback corrects any early or late bias.
map.简谱与五线谱对照查询: Numbered Notation and Staff Notation Lookup
map.它提供稳定参照拍点，让你暴露并纠正拖拍/抢拍；长期跟练把稳定律动内化，演奏更整齐: It gives you a steady reference beat so you can expose and correct rushing or dragging; practising along it long term internalises a stable pulse and makes the playing tighter.
map.偏差多少算好？: How small is a good deviation?
map.业余跟弹 ±20–30 ms 可接受，专业 ±10 ms 内；关键看标准差持续下: For amateur playing, ±20-30 ms is acceptable while professionals aim for ±10 ms; what matters most is that the standard deviation keeps falling rather than any single lucky hit.
